messages.author: 85435c7e2689700c
messages.subject: Bootstrap update policy
parts:
Can the Shiny developers elaborate on how the update to newer versions of Bootstrap will happen following the bump to version 3? As Shiny is now using a version that is under active development, minor releases will occur at intervals. As I understand Bootstraps update policy all updates to version 3 should be backwards compatible so it would be easy to just bump Bootstrap to the most current version every time Shiny sees an update.

My current reason for asking is that the latest version of Bootstrap includes an update to Glyphicon, containing some new icons I would like to use, but I generally see no reason why not keeping up with the Bootstrap version is a good idea. What is the thoughts from RStudio/Shiny?

best Thomas

messages.author: 55771919c42cb6a1
messages.subject: Re: Bootstrap update policy
parts:
Hi Thomas - 

We don't have a specific policy for updating Bootstrap. We don't have a problem with updating Bootstrap, as long as they are bugfix releases, but we're also not committed to keeping on top of the latest version.

For the next Shiny release, I can update to the latest version of Bootstrap.

Also, we do accept pull requests. :)

-Winston
